items.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
items.dek: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.

items.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
items.dek: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has formally come to an end after countries failed to agree a deal.
